description.value: Pangea Pod Hotel is Canada's first pod hotel, placing private capsule-style sleeping pods inside a designer, social setting minutes from Whistler's gondolas. It occupies a hybrid niche between hostel affordability and hotel privacy, with an on-site restaurant and bar (The Living Room) and a rooftop patio that the hotel bills as Whistler's only. The property is explicitly inclusive and welcomes guests of all genders, backgrounds, and sexual orientations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Pangea Pod Hotel is an actively operating boutique pod hotel/hostel hybrid in central Whistler, with consistent address (4333 Sunrise Alley) and phone (+1 604-962-1011) matching OSM. The website makes no mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, tools, wash stations, or any cycling-specific amenities, so both required criteria are null. OSM tags confirm free Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no), and the on-site Living Room restaurant/bar confirms nearby evening food; a postal code discrepancy (OSM: V0N 1B4 vs. privacy policy: V8E 1M7) is flagged.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: OSM lists V0N 1B4 but the website privacy policy states V8E 1M7 — address should be verified with the property.
No bike storage, bike-handling procedures, or cycling-specific facilities mentioned anywhere on the website; required WWC criteria cannot be confirmed without direct contact.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, centrally located Whistler accommodation, but neither secure bike storage nor staff bike procedures are mentioned anywhere on the website; direct outreach is required to verify the WWC required criteria before a directory listing can be confirmed.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Living Room restaurant and bar offers breakfast sandwiches, grab-and-go deals, artisan flatbread pizzas, sandwiches, salads, sharing plates, craft beers, and signature cocktails
